about.text: Milk set or thickened into a soft sweet dessert with starch, flour, egg or gelatin: blancmange, rice pudding, muhallebi and double-skin milk are all milk puddings.

how.text: Milk is sweetened and thickened with starch, flour, egg or gelatin until it sets on cooling.
